t: You're at the Stephen Lawrence Building, part of the Old Royal Naval College in Greenwich. It's named after Stephen Lawrence, a student who lived from 1974 to 1993 and was the victim of a racially motivated murder in Eltham. The building carries his name in remembrance of him. The material I have doesn't go further than that, so I'll simply say this is a place to pause and remember a young life cut short.
